remediation_direction: Modify the Control UI Dashboard's client-side logic to explicitly invalidate or refresh the browser-side authentication token when `resetToolStream` or similar connection reset events occur. This ensures that the UI does not attempt to use stale tokens, aligning its state with the gateway's token rotation/invalidation policies and preventing `AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH` or unauthorized behavior.
validation_plan: Manually expire or rotate an authentication token on the backend/gateway.
Verify that the Control UI dashboard correctly detects the token invalidation and does not display `AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH` or unauthorized errors due to a stale token.
Confirm that the UI either prompts the user for re-authentication or successfully refreshes the token if an automatic refresh mechanism is implemented.
Restart the browser or the UI application after a token rotation/expiration to ensure the fix persists across sessions.
Verify that normal UI operations (e.g., interacting with tools, navigating dashboards) continue to function correctly without unintended re-authentication prompts or errors.
rollback_notes: To roll back, revert the changes made to `ui/src/ui/app-gateway.ts` and `ui/src/ui/app-tool-stream.ts` to their previous versions. This will restore the original client-side token handling behavior, potentially reintroducing the auth drift issue but without affecting backend systems.
